messages:
sam_support: FYI customer (ACME Inc) says ~10k objects are still searchable after their TTL passed yesterday. they moved from 30d -> 90d default around the cutover. customer insists these should have been deleted. trace: trace-id=01FJ8XK2ZQ3AB4C :eyes:
alejandro_sre: are these objects on the old retention tag or were they re-tagged? any tombstone records in the purge queue?
mira_infra: looking. initial check shows a batch migration job ran at 2026-03-09 02:14Z in staged mode (stage=3/5) — some partitions failed with HSM key error: "KMS_KEY_LOCKED". that would prevent final purge. grabbing logs now.
sam_support: customer is asking for timeline — legal wants cert of destruction for items older than 30d. can we confirm which objects are blocked and why.
kyle_eng: if KMS reports locked then deletes are stuck at storage layer; delete api returns 202 and enqueues tombstone but when storage layer tries to re-encrypt/tombstone it fails. need KMS ops to confirm key state and whether rotation was in progress.
legal_jane: we need an interim statement for client: confirm we're investigating, provide expected ETA once keys unlocked. we also need list of object IDs affected (or counts per bucket) for legal file.
retention-bot: automated alert: migration-job(2232) stage=3 -> failures=7 affected-partitions=[us-west-2:15, eu-central-1:3] error=KMS_KEY_LOCKED
alejandro_sre: Mira, can you pull the purge-queue head for the customer and export tombstone IDs? a simple query: `SELECT tombstone_id, bucket, object_id, enqueue_ts FROM purge_queue WHERE customer='acme' AND status='pending' LIMIT 1000;`
mira_infra: ran that, sample: tombstone_id=ts_0145, bucket=acme-backups, object_id=obj_2026-0001, enqueue_ts=2026-03-08T23:42:12Z — ~9.8k pending for acme. errors show KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:1234:key/abcd-locked in logs.
kyle_eng: quick repro steps if someone wants to reproduce locally: 1) set retention to 30d on bucket, 2) create object with past last_modified >30d, 3) call DELETE /v1/objects/:id -> returns 202 with job id, 4) run `GET /internal/purge_jobs/:jobid` shows error state "kms_decrypt_failed". share jobid 0a7f for sample.
oncall_bot: escalation created: INC-2026-83 assigned to eng-infra, priority=P1, sla=4h.
sam_support: thanks. next steps: (1) Mira confirm KMS key health and whether rotation can be aborted/unlocked, (2) Alejandro coordinate accelerated re-run of migration for affected partitions with fallback key if allowed, (3) Legal to prepare client communication (safe harbor statement), (4) Support send interim note to customer.
mira_infra: KMS team confirms key was put into scheduled rotation earlier today and the HSM reported a transient fault; they can either finish rotation (then deletes proceed) or temporarily reassign alias to previous key material. KMS ops prefer finish rotation — estimate 2.5h to recover.
alejandro_sre: we can schedule an expedited migration for affected partitions to use the fallback key alias `redwood-kms-fallback-v1` if Legal signs off on data re-encrypt with fallback. that would allow tombstones to apply immediately.
legal_jane: we need a short memo: what fallback means (re-encrypt under fallback key, audit logs show rewrap), risk of key alias switch, and confirmation that deletion will be irreversible once tombstoned. i can sign once wording is ready.
sam_support: i'll draft an interim update to ACME: "we identified KMS rotation interfering with delete pipeline; we're coordinating a fallback rewrap to complete deletions within ~3h; legal is preparing confirmation. will update in 30m"
kyle_eng: ops note: to verify when deletes complete, run `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/objects?customer=acme&filter=deleted:false&older_than=30d` should return 0 for affected buckets. also check internal metric `purge_queue_pending{customer="acme"}`.
oncall_bot: INC-2026-83 updated: owner=alejandro_sre, expected-resolution=2026-03-10T05:30:00Z
mira_infra: exporting full list of pending tombstones to support ticket now (s3://support-exports/acme/2268459999-pending-tombstones.csv) and attaching KMS event ids for the partitions.
sam_support: copied. Customer notified with interim note. keeping thread open — will post final confirmation once tombstone drain hits 0 and audit logs show successful deletion events. :white_check_mark:
